confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live menus, prices or listings were checked. Food and drink anchors are moderately stable; hotel and hostel rates are least certain given wide July demand swings. EUR converted at an assumed 1.16 USD per EUR (unsourced). Beer assumed as a roughly 330 ml restaurant draft. Cocktail and wine cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 2.6 times beer; wine slightly below beer). RBA rate taken from web search results citing the 4pm 15 Oct 2026 figure; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant, cafe and bar levels benchmarked to Madrid by general knowledge; summer accommodation benchmarked to other high-demand Mediterranean city-break destinations, with a July peak-season premium applied. No external comparable-city data was retrieved.
